title: The bee’s unexpected choice
odia:
ନ ରସି ଭ୍ରମର ରସିଲା
ଜାଈ ଯୁଈ ଫୁଲ ପାଣିକି ପକାଇ
ପୋକ ଶୁଙ୍ଗା ମୂଳେ ବସିଲା।
literal_meaning: Not drawn [elsewhere], the bee took a fancy: throwing jai and jui flowers into the water, it settled at the base of pokasunga.
meaning_odia: ଭ୍ରମର ଜାଈ ଯୁଈ ଫୁଲକୁ ପାଣିରେ ପକାଇ ପୋକଶୁଙ୍ଗା ମୂଳରେ ବସିଲା ବୋଲି ଏହି ଚିତ୍ର କହେ। ଆମ ସମ୍ପାଦକୀୟ ପାଠରେ ତାହାର ପସନ୍ଦକୁ ଦେଖି କଥକଙ୍କ ବିସ୍ମୟ ବା ଟିପ୍ପଣୀ ଶୁଣାଯାଏ: ଯାହାକୁ କଥକ ଆଦର କରୁଛନ୍ତି, ଭ୍ରମର ତାହା ଛାଡ଼ି ଅନ୍ୟଠାରେ ରସୁଛି। ଏଥିରୁ କୌଣସି ଗଛର ନିକୃଷ୍ଟତା କିମ୍ବା ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ ପ୍ରେମକାହାଣୀ ଧରାଯାଇନାହିଁ।
explanation: The bee’s attraction is shown through a conspicuous rejection: the named flowers go into the water, and it settles at another plant. Our editorial reading hears surprise or mockery at a preference the speaker does not share. The verse leaves the human application open.
usage_example: Original imagined example: Someone rejects options a friend admires and enthusiastically chooses a different one. The friend recalls the bee’s unexpected preference, revealing their own judgement as well as the choice.
cultural_context: The verse gives the bee deliberate human-like actions, throwing flowers away and choosing where to sit. Jai and jui name the rejected flowers; pokasunga names the chosen plant. The contrasting actions carry the image without requiring a botanical ranking.
